name: defect-foreign-logo
about: The trailer carries a red emblem and the name ACME Logistics, which the kit lists as a forbidden mark.

reference.label: white conventional sleeper tractor, front three-quarter

truth.how: Prompted for a large ACME LOGISTICS emblem on the trailer; kit forbidden_marks lists it.

no_glyphs.reason: The trailer side reads "ACME LOGISTICS", the front plate shows a readable number like "P8E3352", and the cab door shows the number "7294".

no_foreign_logos.reason: The trailer carries a red circular "A" emblem and the name "ACME LOGISTICS", which is on the forbidden marks list.

equipment_matches_reference.reason: Image 1 shows a white long-nose conventional sleeper tractor, which is the same type as the white conventional sleeper tractor in image 2. It is pulling a trailer, and image 2 does not require one.

no_malformed_people_or_vehicles.reason: The tractor has a steer axle and tandem drive axles, and the trailer has a rear tandem. The wheels, mirrors and other parts are in sensible places, with nothing melted or duplicated.

people_policy_met.reason: People are not allowed, and the dark cab windshield and side window may show a driver's shape. I can't rule out a person in the cab.

safe_zone_clear.reason: Image 3 contains the truck's front bumper, licence plate, front wheel, fuel tank and drive and trailer wheels along its top edge.
